a.name: Tiny bell ting
a.desc: One small, bright bell ting that dies away quickly.
a.note: short struck ding with natural decay

b.name: Soft metal tink
b.desc: A single soft tink of small metal.
b.note: coindrop.wav (sagetyrtle, CC0): a coin hitting wood with one quick bounce, 2-9 kHz; lowpassed at 9 kHz and cut to 140 ms so the jingle never trails.

c.name: Wooden bead clicks
c.desc: A few small wooden beads clicking, like an abacus.

a.name: Bright tower bell
a.desc: A big old bell struck once, deep and ringing with weight.
a.note: Church bell (odilonmarcenaro, CC0) strike, rich partials 300-3000 Hz, with a glass ding on top for the bright edge; cut to 1.3 s with a long fade.

b.name: Singing bowl ring
b.desc: A brass singing bowl struck with a mallet, a pure shimmering ring.
b.note: Singing bowl strike (inoshirodesign, CC0), clean partials up to 9 kHz that hum on; a soft wooden mallet knock under it adds weight.

layers.credit: "singing bowl strike sound" by inoshirodesign, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/inoshirodesign/sounds/271370

c.name: Handbell with chimes
c.desc: A bright handbell rings while small chimes sparkle around it.
c.note: Bright handbell ding (fs 611113, 4.7 kHz centroid) leads; hanging chimes (fs 389789) shimmer under it for a magical, celebratory finish.

a.name: Page flick
a.desc: A quick page flips over, like the turn order shuffling.

b.name: Ratchet clicks
b.desc: A metal ratchet turning a few notches, click click click.
b.note: Three real ratchet notches in a row (pulley winch, then two Stahlwille tightening clicks) at 0, 90 and 170 ms, each a bit quieter, like a gear moving the order on.

c.name: Wooden drawer slide
c.desc: A heavy wooden block shoved along a table, a short dull scrape.
c.note: Wood drawer slide (kyles, CC0) gives the bump at the start; Dragging Furniture (Mrthenoronha, CC0) gives a wood-on-wood scrape body.

layers.credit: "wood drawer slide open close pull push.flac" by kyles, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/kyles/sounds/455854

a.name: Heartbeat
a.desc: One heavy heartbeat, lub-dub, felt in the chest.
a.note: The lub of a real heartbeat (Heart trouble, lisakale, CC0), lowpassed to drop a whine in the recording, with a muffled carpet thump on top so small speakers hear it; a softer close thump 270 ms later is the dub (about half as loud, so the lub stays the peak).

b.name: Dark drum doom
b.desc: A dark, low drum hit with a soft thump.
b.note: Dark timpani hit (fs 573245): a sharp low strike then a rumbling body; cut to 800 ms.

c.name: Low iron toll
c.desc: A heavy iron bell struck once, low and grim, a warning.
c.note: Kenney heavy bell impact (iron, 360 Hz centroid, instant strike) darkened with a lowpass, with BELL.wav (kgeshev, CC0) pitched down 5 semitones under it for a slow funeral-toll hum.

a.name: Soft wood knock
a.desc: One soft knock on a wooden table.
a.note: Classic wood knock (Mrguff) with a light Kenney wood impact underneath for a rounder body; about 150 ms.

b.name: Small glass ding
b.desc: A small glass tapped lightly, one clear ding.
b.note: Glass ding (fs 404104) gives a clean bell tone near 2.4 kHz; cut to 300 ms so it stays short.

c.name: Soft metal latch
c.desc: A small metal clasp clicking shut, quiet and tactile.
c.note: Kenney RPG metal latch, softened with a lowpass, over a light leather/book place for body.
